summary: Remove --function-name flag from equity quote and derivatives; hardcode the NSE API internal routing parameter.
reason: functionName is an NSE internal routing parameter (getSymbolData / getSymbolDerivativesData) that users should never change. Exposing it as a flag caused live dogfood to inject 'example-resource', returning HTTP 400.
validated_outcome: equity quote --symbol RELIANCE returns live price data. Dogfood no longer injects --function-name.
